title: The macOS system must disable the Bluetooth system settings pane.
check_content:
Verify the macOS system is configured to disable the Bluetooth system settings pane with the following command:

/usr/bin/profiles show -output stdout-xml | /usr/bin/xmllint --xpath '//key[text()="DisabledSystemSettings"]/following-sibling::*[1]' - | /usr/bin/grep -c com.apple.BluetoothSettings

If the result is not "1", this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the macOS system to disable the Bluetooth system settings pane by installing the "com.apple.systempreferences" configuration profiles.
VulnDiscussion: The Bluetooth System Setting pane must be disabled to prevent access to the Bluetooth configuration.
